name: Flame-Serpent Will

acquire.equipPiece: One ember-scale armlet on a forearm, a few scales glowing; heat-haze streaks and a small ember trail at the heels.

integrate.transformation: Full armoured form serpent-beastman: wedge head with a flared hood-crest helm, slit molten eyes and fanged jaw, black ember-seam scale plate, clawed digitigrade greaves, a thick ember tail, a forked tongue with spit sacs and a molten fang-blade on the forearm.

equip.weapon: A curved molten fang-blade grown from the forearm, dripping slag.
equip.armor: Black scale plate with glowing ember seams: flared hood-crest helm, scaled pauldrons and bracers, clawed greaves.
equip.hair_eyes: Hair burns away into a flared hood crest; slit molten eyes.
equip.aura: Red-orange heat aura with rising sparks and haze.

lore: The will of an elder serpent whose scales glow like cooling lava: it senses living heat, hides in heat haze, spits molten venom and coils around what it kills.
pitch: The Flame-Serpent Elder is an A-class cinder coil whose scales glow like cooling lava; it senses living heat, hides in haze and spits molten venom. Acquire keeps you human with heat-haze streaks and one equipped piece, a single ember-scale armlet, to see warm bodies through walls and blur in heat haze. Integrate (Full armoured form) makes you a hooded serpent-beastman in black ember-seam plate with a fang-blade, spitting magma and coiling foes; it is the ranged burn A-rank, with less armour than the boar.
untrained: An untrained holder is scorched from inside: ember seams open on the skin, the screen shimmers with heat, and strain rises with every spit or coil. The will lay dormant until forcibly awakened; if the holder cannot balance it the clash tears at body and core and can kill, and only training the holder's own core and the beast core (best teacher: the beast itself) tames it.

spirit.echo: A lithe serpent-beastman in black ember-seam plate: wedge head with a flared hood crest, slit molten eyes, scaled body with glowing ember seams, clawed digitigrade feet, a thick ember-trailing tail, a molten fang-blade.
spirit.look: A glowing red-orange orb with black cooled-crust scales and a slit gold pupil that slowly narrows and widens.
